name: Archive Vlog
summary: Turn everyday clips and photos into a 16:9 mini vlog cut to the beat, with a pale pink title, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Requires Panel runScript/runShell and Draft authoring; ffmpeg and Node.js 18+ on PATH only for music previews and your own music.
